item.title: Amish Fall Farmhouse Experience at Old Windmill Farm — Fri Oct 30 — Old Windmill Farm
item.description:
An autumn afternoon in our farm kitchen. Join us as we bake bread, churn butter from our own cows’ cream, and press apple cider with a traditional hand-cranked apple press. Then sit down and enjoy all three together, with the freshly churned butter on the bread warm from the oven.
Press fresh cider with a traditional press Churn butter from our own cows’ cream Enjoy freshly baked bread Drink cider and eat bread with fresh butter A working farm kitchen, not a demonstration Advance reservations required
Part of the visit is outdoors – dress for the weather. Book This Tour

item.title: Longford Park and Reynold's Dog Park- route along canal — Sun Nov 1, 10:00 AM
item.description:
Walking Tails This week we will walk along the canal. The trail in this direction is dirt and gravel. We will go out about 1.5 miles and then come back the way we came, for a total of 3 miles. CLICK DIRECTLY ON THE MAP IF YOU THINK YOU ARE LOST. IT WILL BRING YOU RIGHT TO US WHERE WE MEET.
We will be meeting near the dog park, come early and let your dog play off leash in the dog park.
Start Time: We will start hiking promptly at the scheduled time.
Duration of the walk – depends on the people and dogs in the group. We frequently end up walking in smaller packs based on the comfort level of the participants. In the past this walk takes about 1 hour or so.
Please remember pooh bags and that your dog must be on a leash that is no more than 10 feet long.
Facilities: There are bathrooms at the dog park
NOTICE: By attending this event you are agreeing that YOU ARE RESPONSIBLE FOR YOUR OWN SAFETY AT ALL TIMES. The hike leader and other members cannot be held responsible for any damages

item.title: SparkDate: Court is in Session — Tue Nov 10, 6:30 PM — Marion Court Room
item.description:
A Lancaster hidden gem that lives up to its name—featuring exposed brick, mood lighting, and a bar set inside a historic courtroom. It’s a room rich with character before you even order a drink. Historical spaces naturally invite people to lower their guard, connect genuinely, and linger past their plans. Combine that atmosphere with a room full of intentional singles, and you have a Tuesday night that actually goes somewhere.
How the Night Works
Check in with your host and grab a name tag—no apps to download, no profile to fill out at the door. The evening unfolds in three distinct phases:
Phase 1: Guided Icebreakers — You’ll be seated at a small table with a casual game to jumpstart the conversation without any forced opening lines. Men rotate one table each round, ensuring every turn brings a fresh set of connections.

item.title: LFS Monthly Discussion - El Serrano's — Wed Dec 2, 6:00 PM
item.description:
Lancaster Freethought Society Come joins us for intelligent discussion and freethinking fun at our monthly meeting. Lancaster Freethought Society is a community for Freethinkers, Atheists, Agnostics, Humanists, Non-believers, Skeptics, and those who are simply curious. There is no fee to attend our meetings which range from topical subjects of interest to freethinkers such as Church/State Separation, as well as subjects such as science, philosophy, ethics, counter-apologetics, and psychology. All are welcome to attend no matter what your beliefs may be but proselytizing is not allowed. Bring your articles, news, jokes, gripes, questions, ideas, topics, or anything else you would like to discuss with the rest of the group.
Hope to see you there!
Source: Meetup: Lancaster Freethought Society
